verses.text: Here is the main point of what we are saying: we have a High Priest like this. He sat down at the right hand of the throne of God, the Majesty in heaven.
He serves in the holy place, the true tent of worship, which was set up by the Lord, not by people.
Every high priest is chosen to offer gifts and sacrifices. So our High Priest also had to have something to offer.
If he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because there are already priests who offer the gifts the law asks for.

They serve in a place that is only a copy and a shadow of what is in heaven. That is why God warned Moses when he was about to build the tent of worship: "Make sure you make everything like the pattern I showed you on the mountain."
But the work Jesus has been given is much better than theirs. In the same way, the covenant he brings between God and people is better, because it is built on better promises.
If the first covenant had been perfect, there would have been no need for a second one.
But God found fault with the people. He said, "The days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.

It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt. They did not stay faithful to my covenant, so I turned away from them, says the Lord.

This is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their minds, and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
They will no longer need to teach their neighbours or their brothers, saying, 'Get to know the Lord.' Everyone will know me, from the least important to the most important.
I will forgive the wrong things they have done, and I will never again remember their sins."
By calling this covenant "new", God has made the first one old. And whatever is old and getting older will soon disappear.
